description: This file declares data structures and functions for array manipulation within the lighttpd server, including operations for managed arrays of various data types such as strings, integers, and generic data sets.

methods.name: array_data_string_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_string object.

methods.name: array_data_array_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_array object.

methods.name: array_data_integer_init
methods.description: Initializes a new data_integer object.

methods.name: array_init
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new array with a specified size.

methods.name: array_copy_array
methods.description: Copies contents from source array to destination array.

methods.name: array_free_data
methods.description: Frees memory associated with data within an array.

methods.name: array_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for an array.

methods.name: array_reset_data_strings
methods.description: Resets string data within the array without deallocating the array itself.

methods.name: array_insert_unique
methods.description: Inserts an entry into the array only if it is not already present.

methods.name: array_pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last element of a simple list array.

methods.name: array_is_vlist
methods.description: Checks if the array is a simple list (vector).

methods.name: array_is_kvany
methods.description: Checks if the array is a key-value array with any key types.

methods.name: array_is_kvarray
methods.description: Checks if the array is a key-value array with string keys.

methods.name: array_is_kvstring
methods.description: Checks if the array is a key-value array with string keys.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen_ext
methods.description: Retrieves an element by key and extension, if exists.

methods.name: array_get_element_klen
methods.description: Retrieves an element by key and length.

methods.name: array_get_data_unset
methods.description: Fetches a data_unset element by key.

methods.name: array_extract_element_klen
methods.description: Removes and returns the element identified by key.

methods.name: array_get_int_ptr
methods.description: Gets a pointer to an integer value stored in the array by key.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr_ext
methods.description: Gets a pointer to a buffer associated with a key and extension.

methods.name: array_get_buf_ptr
methods.description: Gets a pointer to a buffer associated with a key.

methods.name: array_insert_value
methods.description: Inserts a string value into the array.

methods.name: void array_set_key_value(array * const a,const char * const k,const uint32_t klen,const char * const v,const uint32_t vlen)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the array.

methods.name: array_replace
methods.description: Replaces data in the array at the specified key.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_klen
methods.description: Finds an element with a key matching a prefix (length-aware).

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_nc_klen
methods.description: Finds an element with a key matching a prefix, case-insensitive.

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix
methods.description: Finds an element with a key matching a prefix (buffer-based).

methods.name: array_match_key_prefix_nc
methods.description: Finds an element with a key matching a prefix case-insensitively.

methods.name: array_match_value_prefix
methods.description: Finds a value with a matching prefix.

methods.name: array_match_value_prefix_nc
methods.description: Finds a value with a matching prefix, case-insensitive.

methods.name: array_match_key_suffix
methods.description: Finds an element with a key matching a suffix.

methods.name: array_match_key_suffix_nc
methods.description: Finds an element with a key matching a suffix case-insensitively.

methods.name: array_match_value_suffix
methods.description: Finds a value with a suffix match.

methods.name: array_match_value_suffix_nc
methods.description: Finds a value with a suffix match case-insensitively.

methods.name: array_match_path_or_ext
methods.description: Finds an element matching a path or extension.
